parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposures are documented and serious. Police use a morality provision to detain and harass trans women, with a 2009 report of police rape, assault and extortion of trans people. Trans women are held in men's prisons by birth sex, with a 2020 account of rape with guard complicity, prosecutors not investigating, and an official stating there is no way to protect them. A 2017 account records hair-cutting, forced presentation changes and seizure of clothes. Impunity is documented by a regional report. Anti-discrimination articles exist on paper, but no operating enforcement is shown. Killings are recorded (2022 and an undated 2 January case), but raw counts lack denominators, so I do not treat violence as a measured trans-specific rate. Visitor entry, document and screening treatment are unresolved, so I do not add exposure there. Some public organising and visibility exist, but they do not offset the state's custody and policing record. This places the jurisdiction in High Risk, near the 0.25 anchor (sustained police coercion and custody harm) and above the severe tier because gender-identity conduct is not criminalised and no presentation-based sweeps are documented.
